name: Watermelon ZKZ Jeeter XL Infused Pre-Roll | 2g
description: Watermelon ZKZ is an indica cross of the hugely popular Zkittlez and Watermelon. It offers a wonderful fruity aroma and mouthwateringly scrumptious flavor profile. Its high may set in quickly, delivering a powerful, head-rushing euphoria. With its heavy effects, Watermelon ZKZ is best reserved for the end of the day.
